remarks: You will not find a better property near Ellicotville NY.  Close to town to enjoy the shops, restaurants, and ski areas, yet far enough away for privacy and solitude.  This 170 acre tract is one of the most well rounded properties you could own.  There is frontage on 3 roads, a gravel access road partway through property which leads to another internal access road, over 12 miles of atv/utv trails, Wrights Creek and an intermittent stream go through the property, a shooting range field near the west side of the property, and several open areas capable of being used for food plots.  Lower lying areas  have pockets of apples and Hawthorne great for wildlife.  Around 10 acres was heavily cut to promote deer and grouse habitat 7 years ago.  The property is also a tremendous timberland investment.  There is currently over 600MBF of timber as of a cruise in September 2025, with half of the volume in Sugar Maple making a Maple syrup business a viable use for the property although no trees have been historically tapped.  Black Cherry, Red Oak, Red Maple, Beech, and Basswood round out the rest of the inventory.   Cruise information is available upon request.  There is currently merchantable timber ready to be harvested, this property if managed correctly will yield $75k to $100k in timber every 10 to 12 years.  A hunting lease is also available that pays for most of the taxes.  Property is real estate broker owned.
